claims.claim: Intersect requests 1,193,000 ADA, stated as $298,250, to support TSC activities for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds will be returned to the Cardano treasury.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.
The TSC has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts using one Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract with specified multisignature oversight roles.

The proposal claims TSC support is foundational technical governance infrastructure that supports protocol safety, DRep decision-making, and Cardano 2030 strategy KPIs including 99.98% uptime and over 70% DRep participation.

summary: The proposal requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of Intersect TSC support, divided across community-facing coordination, protocol governance, and a 2027 pilot technical review programme, with asserted accounting, audit, smart-contract controls, and NCL compliance.
